en: Hi dear friends! We tried straw and wood, but they were not strong enough!
zh: 嗨，親愛的朋友們！我們試過稻草和木頭，但都不夠堅固！

en: Now we need something hard, heavy and super strong!
zh: 現在我們需要又硬、又重、又超級堅固的東西！

en: I am so excited! We will finally be safe and warm inside!
zh: 我好興奮！我們終於可以安全又溫暖地待在裡面了！

en: No more running away, no more falling houses today!
zh: 不用再逃跑了，今天不會再有房子倒塌了！

en: Is the brick house strong enough to keep the big bad wolf away?
zh: 磚頭蓋的房子夠堅固，能擋住大野狼嗎？

en: Work carefully everyone, make it steady and really strong!
zh: 大家小心蓋，要蓋得穩、蓋得堅固！

en: Our house is made of bricks, it is super strong!
zh: 我們的房子是磚頭做的，超級堅固！

en: Thank you, bricks, for keeping us safe!
zh: 謝謝你，磚頭，保護了我們的安全！

en: We are safe and happy in our strong brick house!
zh: 我們在堅固的磚頭屋裡，安全又快樂！
